name: Karura Forest
subtitle: A large urban forest in northern Nairobi.

facts.label: History
facts.value: Used by Mau Mau fighters during the liberation struggle

facts.label: Land allocation
facts.value: In 1998 almost a third was secretly allocated to developers

parts.text: A large urban forest in northern Nairobi. It sheltered Mau Mau fighters and later became a symbol of resistance to land grabbing.
